sentences.text: Ruehleia is a member of the Saurischia class and belongs to the Plateosauridae family.
The holotype was discovered in 1952 within the Trossingen Formation in central Germany.
The type species R. bedheimensis was named to honor the German paleontologist Hugo Rühle von Lilienstern.
The genus was formally established by Galton in 2001.
This animal lived during the Norian stage, roughly 216 to 208 million years ago, with a broader estimated range between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago.
